keepChannels.title: Channels on the radio
keepChannels.label: Keep channels on the radio
keepChannels.help: On, the channels stay on the radio and follow it into another MeshCore app. Meshloom keeps the last slot for itself.
keepChannels.slots_one: With this radio: {{count}} channel slot kept, plus 1 slot reserved for Meshloom.
keepChannels.slots_other: With this radio: {{count}} channel slots kept, plus 1 slot reserved for Meshloom.
keepChannels.slotsUnknown: Every channel slot but the last one is kept; the last one is reserved for Meshloom.
keepChannels.deleteNote: Deleting a channel in Meshloom also empties its slot on the radio.

fullRestore.channelsKept: The channels stay on the radio. The last slot is left free for Meshloom.
fullRestore.channelsOffloaded: These channels stay on the radio only until the next connection. To keep them there, turn on Settings > Radio > Messaging > Keep channels on the radio.

warnings.channels_offloaded_next_connect: Channels written to the radio until the next connection. To keep them there, turn on Settings > Radio > Messaging > Keep channels on the radio.
